verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istama'a nafarun minal-jinni faqaaloo innaa sami'naa qur'aanan ajabaa
Yahdee ilar-rushdi fa-aamannaa bihi wa lan nushrika birabbinaa ahadaa
Wa annahu ta'aalaa jaddu rabbinaa mat-takhadha saahibatan wa laa waladaa
Wa annahu kaana yaqoolu safeehunaa alaa Allaahi shatataa
Wa annaa zanannaa an lan taqoolal-insu wal-jinnu alaa Allaahi kadhibaa
Wa annahu kaana rijaalun minal-insi ya'oodhoona birijaalin minal-jinni fazaadoohum rahaqaa
Wa annahum zannoo kamaa zanantum an lan yab'atha Allaahu ahadaa
Wa annaa lamasnas-samaa'a fawajadnaahaa muli'at harasan shadeedan wa shuhubaa
Wa annaa kunnaa naq'udu minhaa maqaa'ida lis-sam'i faman yastami'il-aana yajid lahu shihaaban rasadaa
Wa annaa laa nadree asharrun ureeda biman fil-ardi am araada bihim rabbuhum rashadaa
Wa annaa minnas-saalihoona wa minnaa doona dhaalika kunnaa taraa'iqa qidadaa
Wa annaa zanannaa an lan nu'jiza Allaaha fil-ardi wa lan nu'jizahu harabaa
Wa annaa lammaa sami'nal-hudaa aamannaa bihi faman yu'min birabbihi falaa yakhaafu bakhsan wa laa rahaqaa
Wa annaa minnal-muslimoona wa minnal-qaasitoona faman aslama fa-ulaa'ika taharraw rashadaa
Wa ammal-qaasitoona fakaanoo lijahannama hatabaa
Wa allawi istaqaamoo alat-tareeqati l'asqaynaahum maa'an ghadaqaa
Linaftinahum feehi wa man yu'rid an dhikri rabbihi yaslukhu adhaaban sa'adaa
Wa annal-masaajida Lillaahi falaa tad'oo ma'a Allaahi ahadaa
Wa annahu lammaa qaama abdu Allaahi yad'oohu kaadoo yakoonoona alayhi libadaa
Qul innamaa ad'oo rabbee wa laa ushriku bihi ahadaa
Qul innee laa amliku lakum darran wa laa rashadaa
Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allaahi ahadun wa lan ajida min doonihi multahadaa
Illaa balaaghan mina Allaahi wa risaalaatihi wa man ya'si Allaaha wa rasoolahu fa-inna lahu naara jahannama khaalideena feehaa abadaa
Hattaa idhaa ra'aw maa yoo'adoona fasaya'lamoona man ad'afu naasiran wa aqallu adadaa
Qul in adree aqareebun maa too'adoona am yaj'alu lahu rabbee amadaa
Aalimul-ghaybi falaa yuzhiru alaa ghaybihi ahadaa
Illaa manir-tadaa min rasoolin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wa min khalfihi rasadaa
Liya'lama an qad ablaghoo risaalaati rabbihim wa ahaata bimaa ladayhim wa ahsaa kulla shay'in adadaa
